facts.fact: The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications' National Data Governance Policy lists the National Digital Strategy (2025-2029) among the policy instruments Liberia 'has adopted', with a main focus on digital governance and cybersecurity and a Data Marketplace for economic growth; it names no adopting act or date, so the date used is the policy's own (March 2026).

The National Data Governance Policy (March 2026) states that the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications' responsibilities include implementation of the National Digital Strategy (2025-2029) and that it developed the strategy; it names no budget line for the strategy.

systems.tiers: Digital governance, cybersecurity, a Data Marketplace and digital skills
